Chevron Nma Internship 2026 (undergraduate And Postgraduate) For Nigerians: How To Apply

The Chevron NMA Internship is currently open for interested Nigerian undergraduates.

The 2026 Chevron NMA Internship will provide internship employment to undergraduate and postgraduate students who are required to participate in mandatory learning programs. 

Chevron NMA Internship Abstract

  • Host: Chevron

  • Destination: Lagos, Nigeria

  • Category: Internships

  • Benefits:

    • Monthly Stipends

    • Training

    • Employment

    • Living Allowance

  • Eligibility: Nigeria

  • Deadline: June 8, 2026

Chevron Internship Details

The Chevron NMA Internship positions are basically learning opportunities provided by Chevron Nigeria Limited as part of our Corporate Responsibilities.

Chevron Corporation is one of the world’s leading integrated energy companies. Through its subsidiaries that conduct business worldwide, the company is involved in virtually every facet of the energy industry.

Chevron explores for, produces and transports crude oil and natural gas; refines, markets and distributes transportation fuels and lubricants; manufactures and sells petrochemicals and additives.

Chevron also generates power; and develops and deploys technologies that enhance business value in every aspect of the company’s operations.

Interns play supportive roles as assigned to them by the respective work groups. They also learn on the job.

Chevron Internship Requirements

An eligible candidate for the Chevron Internship shall meet the following criteria:

  • The program is open only to Nigerian students studying in-country or overseas. 

  • Candidates must be currently enrolled in an academic program leading to a graduate degree. This could be a Bachelor’s, National Diploma and/or Higher National Diploma.

  • Industry experience must be a requirement to complete the academic program.

  • Applicants must submit a SIWES recommendation letter from their institution as part of the application.

  • Applications must be submitted online through the application portal.

Postgraduate Students

  • Applicants must be currently enrolled in a program leading to a master’s degree, doctorate, or postgraduate professional qualification.

  • The internship has a minimum duration of 6 months and a maximum of 12 months for Master’s students and 24 months for doctoral students.

Pharmacy Internship Requirements

  • The program is open to recent Nigerian graduates with a BSc in Pharmacy from local or international institutions.

  • Applicants must hold a provisional license issued by the Pharmacists Council of Nigeria (PCN).

NMA Medical Laboratory Scientist Internship

  • The program is open to recent Nigerian graduates with a BSc in Medical Laboratory  Science (BMLS) from local or international institutions.

  • Applicants must hold a provisional license issued by the Medical Laboratory Science Council of Nigeria (MLSCN).

NMA Medical Radiographer Internship

  • The program is open to recent Nigerian graduates with a BSc in Medical Radiographer from local or international institutions.

  • Applicants must hold a provisional license issued by the Radiographers Registration Board of Nigeria (RRBN).

Requirements

  • Prospective candidates will be required to obtain a recommendation (SIWES) letter from their institutions which must be submitted with the internship application.

  • All applications must be submitted online through the application portal. 

  • All applicants will go through a shortlisting process which will include aptitude tests. Selections will be strictly based on performance and available space.

Chevron NMA Internship Benefits and Timeline

As an intern at Chevron, you wil get;

Undergraduate resources

  • Monthly Stipends

  • Health Benefits

  • Hands-on training

  • Professional Development

  • Career Advancement and Employment Opportunity

Duration is between 3 and 12 months for selected candidates.

Required Documents for Chevron NMA Internship

  • Current resume

  • Student Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES) letter or support letter from your institution

  • Academic Transcript

Important Notes: The following fields are mandatory and must be fully completed. Not completing them may disqualify your application.

Science

  • Email

  • Mobile Number

  • Institution

  • Academic Discipline

  • Degree

  • State your Internship start and end dates.
